product: On-demand state repartitioning is now generally available
tagline: On demand state repartitioning is now generally available.
what_it_does: On demand state repartitioning is now generally available. You can resize the number of shuffle partitions for a stateful Structured Streaming query or Lakeflow pipeline without losing checkpoint state. Preview This feature is in Public Preview.
why_it_matters: Scale queries up or down to match workload changes.
plain_summary: On demand state repartitioning is now generally available. You can resize the number of shuffle partitions for a stateful Structured Streaming query or Lakeflow pipeline without losing checkpoint state.
key_takeaway: On demand state repartitioning is now generally available.
